title: vercel-labs/json-render: controlled generative interfaces from JSON
friendlyTitle: json-render lets AI build screens from approved parts
summary: json-render is an Apache-licensed framework for turning model-produced JSON into interfaces built from an application’s approved components and actions. The actively maintained project supports web, mobile and terminal renderers and has about 16,800 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: json-render turns structured AI output into user interfaces using components chosen by the developer. It has about 16,800 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Product teams can let an AI compose personalised forms, dashboards or agent interfaces without granting it arbitrary UI code execution. A constrained catalogue makes the output easier to validate, test and keep consistent with a design system.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can build flexible AI-made screens while limiting the model to safe, known building blocks. This is easier to test than letting it write any interface code it wants.
